title: Chicago Fall Cleanup Mistakes That Lead to Lawn Damage
intro: As the vibrant hues of autumn paint the Chicago landscape, homeowners across the city begin to appreciate the changing seasons. However, beneath the picturesque canopy of red, orange, and gold lies a critical task: fall cleanup. For Chicagoans, preparing your lawn and garden for the brutal winter ahead isn't just about aesthetics; it's a vital preventative measure against long-term damage, costly repairs, and a lackluster spring awakening. Many well-intentioned homeowners make common mistakes during this crucial period, inadvertently setting their yards up for failure. Understanding these pitfalls and adopting proper fall leaf removal services and comprehensive cleanup strategies can make all the difference between a resilient landscape and one struggling to recover when spring finally arrives.
